$source: web/app.css :root (Classic, and every non-colour token) and web/themes.css :root[data-theme=...] (the ten other themes). Those stylesheets are the source of truth; this file records them in the shape design-check and the design skills read. Change a value there first, then here.
$themes: Bench has eleven themes, not one light and one dark. color.dark is Classic, the default; color.light is Quiet Temple, the quietest light theme. Every theme defines the same names - see web/themes.css. Classic declares no --well-bg/--well-text: its code sits on --surface-sunken, already dark; the light themes need the well.
$names: Each name here is a CSS custom property in the stylesheets: bg=--bg, surface=--surface-1, surface-raised=--surface-2, surface-sunken=--surface-sunken, surface-rail=--surface-rail, text=--text, text-muted=--muted, primary=--accent, on-primary=--on-accent, border=--line, border-strong=--line-strong, danger=--bad (and --bad-bg, --bad-line), success=--good, warning=--warn, info=--info, wash/scrim/well-*=--wash/--scrim/--well-*; font.size.*=--text-*, space.N=--space-N, radius.default/sm=--radius/--radius-sm, shadow.N=--shadow-N. Components use the custom property, never the value.

family.title: var(--font-title): per theme - the UI face, a serif stack, or the mono face
